description: Baseline architectural invariants for Sovereign FX Trading Bot (NEXUS)

invariants.name: Package Scripts Architecture Guard
invariants.description: package.json dev/build/start scripts must maintain compiled server and node dist execution and never revert to raw unoptimized tsx server.ts

invariants.name: No Stray Installer/Utility Scripts in Root
invariants.description: Files like get-pip.py or stray installer/utility scripts unrelated to project must never exist in repository root

invariants.name: Evolution Validator Real Valgrind Check
invariants.description: evolution_validator.sh must contain a real valgrind invocation and must never be mocked with hardcoded _sim_exit=0

invariants.name: Protected Zones Integrity Guard
invariants.description: The protected-zones EXCLUDED_AREAS list in audit_and_repair.js must never shrink below baseline protected areas count

invariants.name: Ingress Port 3000 Invariant
invariants.description: Server entrypoints and Vite configuration files must enforce port 3000 and not revert to 3001 or 5173
